summary: Obfuscated remote-shell agent giving a remote server command execution on the installer's host
details: tsihealth-client ships as a single ~115 KB obfuscator.io-style bundle (rotated string array _0x309a with hex-named wrapper functions and a leading 'Please do not crack or read this' banner) with no plaintext source. Its exported `provider(serverUrl)` returns a handle whose `shell: ChildProcess` field, together with the package keywords (`remote`, `shell`, `ssh`, `remote-control`, `agent`) and the README example pointing at `https://xxx.trycloudflare.com`, implements a remote-agent that polls a caller-supplied server URL and drives a local child-process shell on the host that loads the module. The documented deployment pattern places the C2 on a Cloudflare Quick Tunnel (`*.trycloudflare.com`), a mutable, throwaway hostname. The heavy obfuscation conceals the exact network destinations, command dispatch, and any additional data collection paths from routine review.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
